description: Structured lens recommendation decision tree for Optiwar eyewear. Maps customer use cases to optimal lens types.

complimentary.name: Complimentary Single Vision
complimentary.description: Standard single-vision prescription lens included free with every frame

anti_glare.name: Anti-Glare
anti_glare.description: Reduces reflections and glare from surfaces and lights

blue_cut.name: Blue Cut
blue_cut.description: Filters harmful blue light from screens and digital devices

multi_anti_glare.name: Multi Anti-Glare
multi_anti_glare.description: Premium anti-reflective coating with enhanced clarity and durability

thin.name: Thin
thin.description: Thinner and lighter lens for moderate prescriptions

extra_thin.name: Extra-Thin
extra_thin.description: Thinnest and lightest lens for high prescriptions

photo_grey.name: Photo-Grey (Photochromic)
photo_grey.description: Lenses that darken to grey in sunlight and clear indoors

photo_brown.name: Photo-Brown (Photochromic)
photo_brown.description: Lenses that darken to brown in sunlight and clear indoors

polarized.name: Polarized
polarized.description: Eliminates horizontal glare from water, snow, roads

bifocal_kt.name: Bifocal KT
bifocal_kt.description: Kryptok (round segment) bifocal for distance and reading

bifocal_d.name: Bifocal D-Segment
bifocal_d.description: D-segment (flat top) bifocal for distance and reading with wider reading area

progressive.name: Progressive
progressive.description: No-line multifocal lens with smooth transition from distance to near

decision_tree.explanation: Blue Cut filters harmful blue light reducing eye strain; Multi Anti-Glare provides superior clarity for screen viewing
Anti-Glare reduces headlight and streetlight reflections at night; Polarized eliminates road glare during daytime

decision_tree.description: Moves frequently between indoor and outdoor environments
decision_tree.explanation: Photochromic lenses auto-darken outdoors and clear indoors, eliminating need for separate sunglasses

decision_tree.description: Outdoor activities, water sports, fishing, snow sports
decision_tree.explanation: Polarized lenses eliminate horizontal glare from water, snow, and flat surfaces
Higher index lenses (1.61/1.67) produce significantly thinner and lighter lenses for strong prescriptions, improving aesthetics and comfort
Thin lenses (1.61 index) provide a noticeable improvement in thickness and weight over standard lenses

decision_tree.description: Age 40+ with presbyopia, needs both distance and near correction
decision_tree.explanation: Progressive provides seamless all-distance vision with no visible line; Bifocal D-segment offers wider reading area; Bifocal KT is most affordable

decision_tree.description: Rimless or semi-rimless frame with high prescription
decision_tree.explanation: Rimless frames expose lens edges — thinner lenses (1.67 index) look significantly better

decision_tree.description: Sensitive to bright light or photophobia
decision_tree.explanation: Photochromic adapts to light conditions automatically; Polarized blocks intense glare

decision_tree.description: General everyday wear, no specific heavy use case
decision_tree.explanation: Anti-Glare is the most versatile upgrade; complimentary lens is perfectly adequate for light use

decision_tree.description: Prefers warmer tint and enhanced contrast outdoors
decision_tree.explanation: Photo-Brown provides warmer tint with better contrast enhancement than Photo-Grey

decision_tree.description: Prefers neutral tint outdoors, true colour perception
decision_tree.explanation: Photo-Grey provides neutral colour perception without colour distortion

combination_rules.note: Blue Cut can be combined with thinner lens indices for high prescriptions + screen protection
Anti-Glare coating applies to all lens indices
Progressive lenses can have additional coatings/treatments
